mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT device_code FROM vm_order_devices WHERE tenant_id = #{customerCode} AND delete_flag = '0'
SELECT DISTINCT channel_code FROM vm_order_devices WHERE tenant_id = #{customerCode} AND delete_flag = '0'

SELECT distinct od.device_code FROM vm_order_devices od left join vm_order_package op on op.package_code = od.package_code LEFT JOIN vm_order_customer co ON co.order_code = od.order_code WHERE op.app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} AND co.user_id = #{userId} AND co.delete_flag = '0' AND op.delete_flag = '0'
select * from vm_order_devices where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} and delete_flag = 0

SELECT de.province_id, de.city_id, de.county_id, de.device_code, de.device_name, ord.industry_code, ord.app_ver_code as appVersion, de.town_code town_code FROM vm_order_devices ord JOIN vm_device_info_t de ON de.device_code = ord.device_code WHERE de.delete_flag = '0' AND de.province_id != '' AND de.province_id IS NOT NULL AND de.city_id != '' AND de.city_id IS NOT NULL AND de.county_id != '' AND de.county_id IS NOT NULL AND ord.order_code = #{orderCode} and ord.ord_status in (0,1,2) ORDER BY de.province_id, de.city_id, de.county_id, de.town_code
SELECT AREA_CODE, AREA_NAME, AREA_PARENT_CODE, AREA_PARENT_NAME, DEPT_ID FROM sys_area ar WHERE ar.DEL_FLAG = '0' ORDER BY ar.AREA_CODE

SELECT distinct a.device_code, a.order_code, a.package_code FROM vm_order_devices a WHERE a.order_code = #{orderCode} AND a.package_code = #{packageCode} AND a.delete_flag = '0' ${dataScope} ORDER BY a.create_time,a.id desc
